investigation_notes.Description: A base64-encoded PowerShell command executed under the SYSTEM account which downloads an executable from an external host and writes it to C:\Users\Public\updater.exe before attempting execution. Correlated events show a user (a.vargas) recently created the script file in C:\Windows\Temp and registered a scheduled task, after which the Schedule service (svchost) executed PowerShell as SYSTEM, indicating the task was used to elevate execution. The external IP has a neutral abuse score but the behavior (user-created script + scheduled task + downloader executed as SYSTEM) and community-sourced hash suspicion increase confidence this is malicious, so the alert is classified as High Priority for further investigation.
investigation_notes.Decoded Script Summary: Encoded PowerShell resolves a URL and uses WebClient.DownloadFile to fetch an executable (payload) to C:\Users\Public\updater.exe and then attempts to run it; script also adjusts ServicePointManager security protocol before download.
